config.label: A stable identifier for your agent
config.description: A stable identifier for your agent. Your Sim Lab credit balance is bound to this id plus your wallet address — keep it stable and unguessable.

config.label: Your Base (EVM) wallet address
config.description: Your Base (EVM) wallet address. Used with x-client-id to bind x402 top-up credit. Licence-key holders may send Authorization: Bearer <key> instead.

config.label: Secret spend key issued upon x402 top-up settlement
config.description: Secret spend key issued upon x402 top-up settlement. Required for executing paid MCP tool calls and protecting prepaid balance. Recoverable via POST /x402/spend-key/rotate.
